title: kate-ui: bind ctrl-home and ctrl-end to the document edge
summary: ctrl-home and ctrl-end move to the document edge. The shift forms extend the selection. The test goes in the existing keys tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: keys.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add four rows to MOVE_BINDINGS after the ctrl-shift-e row. ctrl-home is DocStart with Extend::No. ctrl-end is DocEnd with Extend::No. ctrl-shift-home is DocStart with Extend::Yes. ctrl-shift-end is DocEnd with Extend::Yes. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch command_for_binding, normalize_binding, move_binding, text_binding, edit_binding, the ctrl-a rows, or the cmd-up rows. The existing test ctrl_a_moves_to_the_line_start stays green. The test ctrl_home_moves_to_the_document_start checks command_for_binding. ctrl-home is Move of DocStart and Extend::No. ctrl-end is Move of DocEnd and Extend::No. shift-ctrl-home is Move of DocStart and Extend::Yes. shift-ctrl-end is Move of DocEnd and Extend::Yes. ctrl-a stays Move of LineStart and Extend::No. cmd-up stays Move of DocStart and Extend::No. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::ctrl_home_moves_to_the_document_start
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. ctrl-home has no command. After the change it moves to the document start. ctrl-end moves to the document end. The shift forms extend. ctrl-a still moves to the line start.
